subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Abhor
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4) i.e. **"Love"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abhor**: (घृणा करना) - To regard with disgust and hatred.

 
 
• **Example**: He abhors violence in any form.
 
 
 
• **Love**: (प्यार करना) - To feel a deep romantic or an intense feeling of deep affection.
 
 
• **Example**: She loves her husband very much.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Love".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Occupy**: (कब्जा करना) - To fill or take up (a space or time).
 
• **Despise**: (तिरस्कार करना) - To feel contempt or a deep repugnance for.
 
• **Danger**: (खतरा) - The possibility of suffering harm or injury.
